mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.help.qna.QnaManageMapper.selectQnaListDetail */ SELECT c.QA_ID AS qaId, c.QESTN_SJ AS qestnSj, c.QESTN_CN AS qestnCn, c.WRITNG_PASSWORD AS writngPassword, c.AREA_NO AS areaNo, c.MIDDLE_TELNO AS middleTelno, c.END_TELNO AS endTelno, c.EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres, c.EMAIL_ANSWER_AT AS emailAnswerAt, c.WRTER_NM AS wrterNm, c.WRITNG_DE AS writngDe, c.ANSWER_CN AS answerCn, c.ANSWER_DE AS answerDe, c.RDCNT AS inqireCo, c.QNA_PROCESS_STTUS_CODE AS qnaProcessSttusCode, d.CODE_NM AS qnaProcessSttusCodeNm, a.USER_NM AS emplyrNm, a.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno, a.EMAIL_ADRES AS aemailAdres, b.ORGNZT_NM AS orgnztNm, DATE_FORMAT(c.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS frstRegisterPnttm, c.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, DATE_FORMAT(c.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastUpdusrPnttm, c.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastUpdusrId FROM LETTNQAINFO c LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE d ON d.CODE_ID = 'COM028' AND c.QNA_PROCESS_STTUS_CODE = d.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNEMPLYRINFO a ON a.ESNTL_ID = c.LAST_UPDUSR_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNORGNZTINFO b ON a.ORGNZT_ID = b.ORGNZT_ID WHERE c.QA_ID = #{qaId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.help.qna.QnaManageMapper.insertQnaCn */ INSERT INTO LETTNQAINFO ( QA_ID, QESTN_SJ, QESTN_CN, WRITNG_PASSWORD, AREA_NO, MIDDLE_TELNO, END_TELNO, EMAIL_ADRES, EMAIL_ANSWER_AT, WRTER_NM, WRITNG_DE, RDCNT, QNA_PROCESS_STTUS_CODE, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID ) VALUES ( #{qaId}, #{qestnSj}, #{qestnCn}, #{writngPassword}, #{areaNo}, #{middleTelno}, #{endTelno}, #{emailAdres}, #{emailAnswerAt}, #{wrterNm}, DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d'), 0, '1', SYSDATE(), #{frstRegisterId} )
mapper.update: /* com.portal.user.help.qna.QnaManageMapper.updateQnaCn */ UPDATE LETTNQAINFO SET QESTN_SJ = #{qestnSj}, QESTN_CN = #{qestnCn}, WRITNG_PASSWORD = #{writngPassword}, AREA_NO = #{areaNo}, MIDDLE_TELNO = #{middleTelno}, END_TELNO = #{endTelno}, EMAIL_ADRES = #{emailAdres}, EMAIL_ANSWER_AT = IFNULL(#{emailAnswerAt}, 'N'), WRTER_NM = #{wrterNm}, WRITNG_DE = DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d'), FRST_REGIST_PNTTM = SYSDATE(), FRST_REGISTER_ID = #{frstRegisterId} WHERE QA_ID = #{qaId}
mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.help.qna.QnaManageMapper.selectQnaAnswerListDetail */ SELECT c.QA_ID AS qaId, c.QESTN_SJ AS qestnSj, c.QESTN_CN AS qestnCn, c.WRITNG_PASSWORD AS writngPassword, c.AREA_NO AS areaNo, c.MIDDLE_TELNO AS middleTelno, c.END_TELNO AS endTelno, c.EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres, c.EMAIL_ANSWER_AT AS emailAnswerAt, c.WRTER_NM AS wrterNm, c.WRITNG_DE AS writngDe, c.ANSWER_CN AS answerCn, c.ANSWER_DE AS answerDe, c.RDCNT AS inqireCo, c.QNA_PROCESS_STTUS_CODE AS qnaProcessSttusCode, d.CODE_NM AS qnaProcessSttusCodeNm, a.USER_NM AS emplyrNm, a.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno, a.EMAIL_ADRES AS aemailAdres, b.ORGNZT_NM AS orgnztNm, DATE_FORMAT(c.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS frstRegisterPnttm, c.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, DATE_FORMAT(c.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastUpdusrPnttm, c.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastUpdusrId FROM LETTNQAINFO c LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE d ON d.CODE_ID = 'COM028' AND c.QNA_PROCESS_STTUS_CODE = d.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNEMPLYRINFO a ON a.ESNTL_ID = c.LAST_UPDUSR_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNORGNZTINFO b ON a.ORGNZT_ID = b.ORGNZT_ID WHERE c.QA_ID = #{qaId}
